channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Modern Industrials raises $6M seed to build custom AI agents for manufacturers and distributors
item.description: Modern Industrials raised a $6 million seed round to build custom AI agents for manufacturers and distributors.

item.title: WhatsApp usernames and BSUID: API changes for business
item.description: WhatsApp is rolling out usernames so customers can chat without sharing a phone number, and businesses will see a new business-scoped user ID in API webhooks instead.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.171.0 and Claude Code 2.1.330 ship the same day
item.description: Codex CLI 0.171.0 and Claude Code 2.1.330 both shipped on November 20, with GPT-6.2 Sol now the default model in Codex.

item.title: Pragmatik Labs raises new round at ~$5B valuation; Oracle fully funds its OpenAI buildout
item.description: Pragmatik Labs raised a new round at about a $5 billion valuation, and Oracle says its OpenAI infrastructure buildout is now fully funded.

item.title: Okta extends MCP governance to every hop of an agent's tool calls
item.description: Okta extended its MCP governance so every step of an AI agent's tool calls is scoped, audited, and tied to the person who requested it.

item.title: Cloudflare Agents SDK v0.34.0 brings Pi 1.6 tools that wait without staying awake
item.description: Cloudflare's Agents SDK now lets AI agent tools wait for a person or a deadline without staying awake and burning compute.

item.title: MCP drafts an experimental file uploads and downloads extension
item.description: The Model Context Protocol published a draft extension for uploading and downloading files outside the model's context.
